textPrompt: Create a premium, fully responsive, multi-section website titled 'Beyond Earth — The Future of Space Exploration'. The website should feel like a world-class interactive science and technology experience. Include an immersive hero section, an introduction to space exploration, reusable rockets, lunar missions, Mars exploration, technologies for deep-space travel, future missions, and a compelling conclusion. Use sophisticated typography, cinematic visual storytelling, dramatic dark backgrounds, carefully controlled luminous accents, and varied editorial layouts. Incorporate high-quality, contextually relevant imagery of spacecraft, astronauts, rocket launches, the Moon, Mars, and futuristic space technology. Where AI image generation is available, generate original visuals that match the selected design direction. Use image-led sections, asymmetric grids, full-width visual narratives, elegant cards, and polished transitions. Avoid generic templates, excessive empty space, repetitive sections, unrelated images, placeholder content, and invented factual claims. Ensure all images are correctly loaded, mobile responsiveness is excellent, and assets are included in the downloadable website ZIP.
